text: Take a few moments and settle into a comfortable position.
Keep your eyes closed gently.
Allow yourself to set a simple intention for this session.
An intention to let the body feel supported.
And to allow the nervous system to settle into a calm, steady rhythm.
Allow your attention to turn inward.
Hold the surface beneath you.
Notice how your body is already being held.
Begin by becoming aware of the energy at the top of your head.
A quiet ease spreading across the scalp.
Let that ease move into your forehead.
Across the space behind the eyes.
Down through the jaw.
The tongue resting easily in the mouth.
Allow all the muscles in your face to begin to relax and unwind.
Take your attention.
Now bring awareness to the neck and shoulders.
To the neck and shoulders.
Imagine a gentle warmth moving through this area.
The shoulders settling downward, supported by gravity.
Let this warmth continue into the arms.
Into the arms.
Through the upper arms.
The elbows.
The forearms.
All the way into the hands and fingers.
They can simply rest.
Bring awareness into the chest.
The chest.
Notice the rhythm of your breathing.
Breathing.
Breath moving in and out at its own pace.
Each breath becomes a signal of safety.
A quiet message to the nervous system that it is okay to soften.
Feel the breath moving into the stomach.
The gentle rise and fall with each cycle.
The body responding naturally.
Allow awareness to move through the back.
Across the upper back.
The middle back.
The lower back.
Muscles releasing in layers.
The spine supported.
The inner back.
Now bring attention into the hips and pelvis.
A sense of grounding here.
Stability.
Support.
Let that feeling travel down through the thighs.
The knees.
The calves.
All the way into the feet.
Feel the feet resting.
Connected.
Stable.
At this point the nervous system begins to recognize a deeper level of calm.
A steady baseline emerging.
Your thoughts may come and go.
Sensations may shift.
Everything is allowed to move at its own pace.
You may notice a sense of internal quiet developing.
Not empty.
You may notice a sense of internal quiet.
